name: open-autofill
description: Browser extension for automatic form filling with Google Sheets sync

scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:css && node scripts/build.js firefox
scripts.build:chrome: npm run build:css && node scripts/build.js chrome
scripts.pack:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r ../open-autofill-firefox.zip .
scripts.pack:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../open-autofill-chrome.zip .
scripts.pack: npm run build && cd dist/firefox && zip -r ../open-autofill-firefox.zip . && cd ../chrome && zip -r ../open-autofill-chrome.zip .
